versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "Novel Writing Techniques" skill, covering six core professional techniques: dual narrative/mirroring, character biography method, foreshadowing, poetic language style, morally gray character development, and intellectual duel design.
- Provides step-by-step workflow for both single technique guidance and multi-technique project-level consultations.
- Includes a structured output format (diagnosis, solution, example, extension) for all writing technique questions.
- Offers tiered technique depth suitable for beginners, intermediates, and professionals.
- Details the interconnections and synergy between the six key novel writing techniques to enhance overall literary quality.
